hooks.prompt: Act as a read-only pre-commit cleanliness gate. Read .claude/skills/pre-commit-cleanup/SKILL.md and use its criteria. Inspect git status, the unstaged diff, and the staged diff. Do not edit files. Return ok=true only when the pending changes contain no AI running notes, temporary plans, prompt fragments, debugging artifacts, redundant comments, or excessive documentation. Preserve legitimate documentation and explanations of non-obvious decisions. If cleanup is needed, return ok=false with exact files and issues, and instruct the main Claude session to invoke /pre-commit-cleanup before retrying the commit. Hook input: $ARGUMENTS
hooks.statusMessage: Checking the diff for AI artifacts...
